# Architecture — Islam Elsayed portfolio (https://tpct.github.io)

Owner: Tech Lead · Date: 2026-10-21 · Size: M · Inputs: `brief.md`, `prd.md`, `ux.md`, `content.json`.
`ux.md` is the normative design system (tokens, markup, behaviour). This document decides **how** it is built.

## 1. Approach

**Zero-dependency static build.** Plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS, rendered from `src/content.json` by a small Node (ESM) build script into `dist/`. No framework, no npm runtime or dev dependencies, no bundler. GitHub Actions runs the build, the tests and the confidentiality check, then deploys `dist/` to GitHub Pages.

### Alternatives considered
| Option | Verdict |
|---|---|
| Astro (static output) | Rejected. Adds ~200 MB of node_modules, a lockfile to maintain and a framework to learn, for one page plus a 404. Nothing in the PRD needs components, MDX or image pipelines. |
| Eleventy / other SSG | Rejected for the same reason; templating is trivial here. |
| Hand-written `index.html` | Rejected: PRD requires "adding a project = edit content.json only" and build-time validation of content. |
| **Node build script + template-literal renderers** | **Chosen.** ~1 small file per concern, full control over byte-exact markup from ux.md, CSP hash computed at build time, zero supply-chain surface, builds in < 1 s. |

## 3. Build pipeline (`scripts/build.mjs`)

1. Read `src/content.json`. `JSON.parse` failure → throw with file name + message.
2. `validateContent(c)` → if any errors, print each on its own line and exit 1 (CLI) / throw (API). Fails on: missing required keys, project `category` not in `categories`, duplicate project ids, unknown `kind`, open-source without a valid `repoUrl` (`^https://github\.com/TPCT/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`), non-integer `year`, nav `href` not starting with `#`. A `repoUrl` on a case study is only a warning (renderer ignores it — PRD US-15 edge).
3. Clean `outDir` (default `dist/`), copy `public/` recursively.
4. Concatenate `src/styles/*.css` (sorted by name) → `assets/site.css`; `src/scripts/*.js` (sorted) → `assets/site.js`. Each gets a cache-buster `?v=<first 10 hex of sha256(content)>` in the HTML links (Pages caches ~10 min).
5. Render `index.html` and (from T-003) `404.html`, `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, `site.webmanifest`.
6. Exported API: `export async function build({ outDir = "dist", root = <repo root> } = {})` returns `{ outDir, files: string[] }`. CLI guard: run only when `import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href`. Tests call `build({ outDir: <tmpdir> })`.

**Rendering rules.** Renderers are pure functions `(c, ...) => string` using template literals. Every content string goes through `esc()` (`& < > " '`), every attribute value through `attr()` (same escaping). No raw HTML in content.json. No inline `style=""` attributes and no inline event handlers anywhere (CSP).

## 4. Security / CSP

`<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy">` placed directly after `<meta charset>` and viewport:

```
default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'sha256-<HASH>'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; manifest-src 'self'
```

- `<HASH>` = base64 sha256 of the exact inline theme script body from ux.md §6, **computed by the build** from the same string constant that is emitted (no manual re-hash).
- No `style=""` attributes → the ux.md `style="--i:N"` stagger is replaced by `:nth-child(N)` rules setting `--i` in CSS (decision D6). JS may set styles through CSSOM (`el.style.x = ...`), which CSP allows.
- JSON-LD (`type="application/ld+json"`) is a data block, not executed; allowed.
- External links: `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"`.

## 5. Browser JS

One deferred file `/assets/site.js` (`<script src defer>` at the end of `<head>`), ES2020, no modules, each source file an IIFE that no-ops if its DOM hooks are absent (so the same bundle runs on `/` and `/404.html`). Budget ≤ 30 KB gzip (expected < 6 KB).
- `10-theme.js`: toggle (ux §4.2/§6), localStorage wrapped in try/catch.
- `20-nav.js`: mobile menu disclosure (< 768px via `matchMedia`), in-page anchor focus enhancement.
- `30-filter.js`: category × kind filter, counts, live region, empty state, URL state (ux §4.7).
- `40-copy.js`: copy email (ux §4.10).
- `50-scrollspy.js`: IntersectionObserver `aria-current` (ux §4.2).

No-JS: `<html class="no-js">`; inline script swaps to `js`. Filters, theme toggle, menu button and copy button are server-rendered with `hidden` and only revealed by JS.

`src/content.json` = `.company/content.json` + the ux.md §9 keys merged in (exact strings):
`site.menuOpen`, `site.menuClose`, `sections.{skills,experience,services,process}`, `hero.domainsLabel`, `projectsIntro.{kindFilterLabel,countSingular,countPlural,resetLabel,roleLabel,stackLabel}`, `a11y.newTab`.

Derived at build time: category slugs (ux §4.7 rule), featured-first project order (stable), per-category/per-kind counts, section index labels (`01`…`07`).

Section heading text map (no new strings):
| Section id | Index label (decorative) | h2 |
|---|---|---|
| about | `01 / ` + nav label "About" | `about.title` |
| experience | `02 / ` + `sections.experience` | `sections.experience` |
| skills | `03 / ` + nav label "Stack" | `sections.skills` |
| work | `04 / ` + nav label "Work" | `projectsIntro.title` |
| services | `05 / ` + `sections.services` | `sections.services` |
| process | `06 / ` + `sections.process` | `sections.process` |
| contact | `07 / ` + nav label "Contact" | `contact.title` |

JSON-LD Person (T-003): `name`=hero.name, `jobTitle`=hero.roles.slice(1), `url`=`https://tpct.github.io/`, `email`=`mailto:`+contact.email, `sameAs`=[contact.github, contact.website], `worksFor`={Organization ShiftCodes, url contact.website}, `address`={PostalAddress, addressLocality "Alexandria", addressCountry "EG"} (locality = first comma part of contact.location; country code is a build constant).

## 7. Confidentiality guard (`scripts/check-confidential.mjs`, T-003)

- Scans (a) every file under `dist/` and (b) every file from `git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard` (tracked + would-be-committed; gitignored paths such as `.company/private/` are never read). Skips binary files (NUL byte in the first 8 KB) and the script's own test fixtures dir.
- Rule 1: regex `/[a-z0-9-]+\.(shiftcodes\.net|xcutor\.net)/i` → any match fails. The bare `shiftcodes.net` passes.
- Rule 2: denylist from `.company/private/denylist.txt` (gitignored, optional). One literal term per line, `#` comments and blank lines ignored; matched case-insensitively as a whole token (`(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])term(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])`, term regex-escaped). File missing → print `denylist: not found, skipped` and continue (CI case).
- Output: `file:line: <rule>` per hit — **never print the matched denylist term itself** (CI logs are public); print the rule name and term index only. Exit 1 on any hit, 0 otherwise. Also fails if `dist/` is missing.
- The denylist file is created and maintained by the **lead (Claude)** from `.company/private/readmes.md` (`vis: private` names, minus generic words and names that are public in content.json such as "AIC"). Codex never sees or writes it.

## 8. Images and font (T-003)

- **Font:** Archivo variable (OFL 1.1) subset to wght 400–800, wdth 100–125 and the ux.md §2.2 unicode list → `public/assets/fonts/archivo-var.woff2` (target ≤ 80 KB, hard cap 120 KB) + `OFL.txt`. Built once with fonttools in a throwaway venv outside the repo (`scripts/build-font.sh` documents it). Fallback if fonttools/pip cannot be used: `@fontsource-variable/archivo` (`npm pack`, outside the repo) `files/archivo-latin-wdth-normal.woff2`. Committed; never fetched at runtime or in CI.
- **OG + icons:** `scripts/render-images.mjs` (dev only) generates `src/images/og-image.svg` from content per ux.md §8, renders it in headless Chromium through `playwright-core` resolved from `$PLAYWRIGHT_CORE` (path) with `executablePath` from `$CHROME_PATH`, and writes the PNGs into `public/`. ICO is assembled in Node (PNG-in-ICO, 16+32). Outputs are committed; CI never launches a browser.

## 9. Deploy (T-004)

`.github/workflows/pages.yml`, on `push` to `main` + `workflow_dispatch`. `permissions: contents: read, pages: write, id-token: write`; `concurrency: { group: pages, cancel-in-progress: false }`.
- Job `build` (ubuntu-latest): `actions/checkout@v7` → `actions/setup-node@v7` (node 22) → `npm run build` → `npm test` → `npm run check:confidential` → `actions/configure-pages@v6` → `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5` (`path: dist`).
- Job `deploy`: `needs: build`, `environment: { name: github-pages, url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }} }`, `actions/deploy-pages@v5`.
- Any failing step stops before deploy → live site stays on the previous version (US-20 AC2). No `npm ci` (no dependencies, no lockfile).
- Versions verified 2026-10-21 via `gh api repos/actions/<name>/releases/latest`: checkout v7.0.1, setup-node v7.1.0, configure-pages v6.0.0, upload-pages-artifact v5.0.0, deploy-pages v5.0.1.

## 10. Test strategy

- **Unit/integration (node --test, no deps):** `npm test` = `node --test test/*.test.mjs`. Tests build into an OS tmp dir via `build({outDir})` and assert on the HTML string with regexes/`includes` (no DOM library).
  - content: schema valid, §9 keys present, every category used/declared, slugs unique.
  - build: one `<h1>`, all section ids, nav targets exist, CSP hash matches inline script, no `style="`, no inline `on*=`.
  - projects: card count = projects.length, featured-first order, case-study cards contain no `<a`, OSS cards link exactly `repoUrl`, no `undefined`, chip counts.
  - seo: title/description/canonical/OG/Twitter/JSON-LD, robots, sitemap, manifest, 404 noindex, OG PNG 1200×630 ≤ 300 KB, font magic `wOF2`.
  - confidential: script fails on a planted fixture leak, passes on clean dist.
- **Per Codex round:** only the affected test file(s) + `node --check` on changed browser JS. Leads run `npm run check` (build + all tests + confidentiality) once at the review gate.
- **QA (Claude, after T-004):** Playwright/axe in both themes at 360/768/1024/1440, Lighthouse mobile, no-JS pass, live-site checks (US-14 AC3, US-19 AC1).

## 11. Risks
| Risk | Mitigation |
|---|---|
| Private names leak into the public repo | Rule 1 + denylist in CI and locally; tickets/docs never quote private names; check prints no matched terms. |
| Font tooling unavailable offline | Two acquisition routes; site degrades to the metric-matched fallback if the file is missing. |
| CSP breaks the theme script after an edit | Hash computed from the same constant at build; test asserts it. |
| Lighthouse perf from 1 font + CSS | Single preload, `font-display: swap`, metric-matched fallback, CSS < 40 KB. |
| T-002 is the largest ticket | It touches only section renderers/CSS/JS; if the Codex round overruns, split filter JS into a follow-up fix ticket. |

## 12. Decisions log (Tech Lead)
- D1 Stack: zero-dependency Node build (no Astro) — §1.
- D2 Content moved to `src/content.json`; `.company/content.json` deleted by the lead after T-001 (Codex may not edit `.company/`).
- D3 CSS/JS split into ordered partials concatenated at build, one request each, with content-hash cache busting.
- D4 No linters/html-validate dependency; correctness via node tests. QA covers axe/Lighthouse.
- D5 CSP via meta tag; hash computed at build.
- D6 Hero stagger uses `:nth-child` CSS instead of `style="--i:N"` (CSP `style-src 'self'`).
- D7 OG/icons/font are committed binaries produced by dev-only scripts; CI never runs a browser or downloads fonts.
- D8 Confidentiality denylist lives only in gitignored `.company/private/denylist.txt`, owned by the lead; CI skips it.
- D9 Actions pinned to current majors (checkout v7, setup-node v7, configure-pages v6, upload-pages-artifact v5, deploy-pages v5), Node 22.
- D10 No code licence file: site content is personal (© Islam Elsayed); third-party notices (Archivo OFL, Lucide ISC) in README and `OFL.txt`.
- D11 Local preview via `scripts/serve.mjs` (Node http, serves `dist/`, 404 → `404.html` with status 404).

## 13. Prism reskin (T-005..T-008)
Spec: `ux-prism.md` (normative visual + motion layer; IA/behaviour from `ux.md` unchanged).

**Ticket split (file ownership, no overlaps after T-005):**
| Ticket | Owns | New test file |
|---|---|---|
| T-005 | fonts, `00-`..`40-` + new `15-motion.css`, `head.mjs`/`hero.mjs`/`icons.mjs`/`validate.mjs`, `content.json`, README notices | edits `build`/`seo`/`content` tests |
| T-006 | `sections.mjs` (`data-reveal` only), `50-`..`90-` CSS | `test/sections.test.mjs` |
| T-007 | `10-theme.js`, `30-filter.js`, new `60-motion.js`, `61-pointer.js` | `test/scripts.test.mjs` |
| T-008 | `scripts/render-images.mjs` + the 8 generated image/icon files | `test/images.test.mjs` |
T-006/T-007/T-008 can run in parallel once T-005 is merged.

**Motion gates** (§5.1): `html.js` (inline head script) gates only the pure-CSS hero entrance (`animation-fill-mode: both`); `html.motion` (added by `60-motion.js` when reduced motion is off and IO exists) gates scroll reveals and ambient loops; `html.motion-paused` pauses loops (persisted in `localStorage.motion = 'paused'|'running'`). Every `@keyframes` sits in `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`; the global reduce rule in `10-base.css` stays. Animations use only transform/translate/rotate/scale/opacity (theme reveal `clip-path` on view-transition snapshots is the single exception). No-JS and reduced-motion users get the full static design.

**Decisions**
- D12 Visual reskin replaces the visual layer only; markup changes limited to hero word spans, `.hero__visual`/`.prism`/motion toggle (T-005) and bare `data-reveal` hooks (T-006).
- D13 Fonts: self-hosted Outfit + Plus Jakarta Sans woff2 subsets (OFL), metric-matched fallbacks; Archivo removed. Alternative (Google Fonts CDN) rejected: breaks self-only CSP and adds a third-party request.
- D14 Backdrop-filter budget = 3 elements (header pill, mobile menu, hero domains plate); plates/cards are near-opaque gradients. Alternative (glass on every card) rejected for scroll/animation cost on mid-range phones.
- D15 Per-element motion values via CSSOM `style.setProperty` only (CSP `style-src 'self'` forbids `style=` attributes); static indices via `:nth-child`.
- D16 JS budget: `site.js` ≤ 16,000 bytes (spec's 14,000 assumed a 7.6 KB base; actual ~8.8 KB). Per file: 60-motion ≤ 3,000, 61-pointer ≤ 1,900, 10-theme ≤ 1,500, 30-filter ≤ 5,000. CSS ≤ 45 KB.
- D17 Filter animation uses WAAPI FLIP (finer control, no page snapshot); View Transitions API only for the theme circle reveal, with an instant fallback.
- D18 JS behaviour is tested by static checks + a `node:vm` smoke run with a stub DOM (no jsdom dependency); real behaviour is verified eyes-on in QA.
- D19 OG SVG references fonts by URL relative to the SVG and is rendered from the committed file; no absolute local path may appear in committed files (test scans `src/ public/ scripts/`). Earlier commits keep the old SVG (no history rewrite; accepted low risk).

**Risks:** compact JS under tight byte caps may hurt readability (mitigated by review); `display: contents` on `#about .section-head` at lg means its reveal is a no-op there (accepted); view transitions are Chromium/Safari only (instant fallback elsewhere).

## 14. Wow round (T-010..T-014, on top of T-007 + T-015)
- Spec: `.company/ux-wow.md` (W-1..W-5). Baseline: T-015 has landed (one-pad rhythm, desktop `.spine`, chapter nodes `.is-lit`).
- New partials only. JS: `70-field.js`, `71-decode.js`, `72-spot.js`, `73-timeline.js`. CSS: `41-field`, `42-type`, `43-hero-wow`, `55-timeline`, `56-marquee`, `61-cards-live`. Each chunk owns disjoint files. `sections.mjs` is shared by T-013 → T-014, which run sequentially.
- Budgets:
  - `site.js` cap = B + 8,192 (B = cap after T-015).
  - CSS caps +16,384 raw / +4,096 gzip.
  - Both are raised once, in T-010.
- Data: `content.timeline` (verbatim from `.company/timeline.json`), `timelineIntro`, `sections.timeline`, and nav "Journey". All are validated in `validate.mjs`. Years go out of order → warning only.
- Decisions:
  - The card state class is `is-spot` (avoids T-015's `.is-lit`).
  - The timeline line reuses the spine's track/fill gradients.
  - The draw is JS-driven and monotonic (alternative: CSS scroll-timeline, rejected because Firefox lacks it and node-lighting sync matters).
  - The constellation is canvas 2D, confined to the hero (alternative: full-page field, rejected for its paint cost).
- Risks:
  - Canvas cost on low-end devices. Mitigated by adaptive N, then auto-disable; 30fps on coarse pointers.
  - Byte creep. Each file has its own cap test.
  - Confidentiality of timeline copy. Covered by a scoped `checkConfidential` test on the rendered section.
- Tests: one new test file per chunk, plus the shared vm smoke test. The lead runs the full suite, Lighthouse/axe and the eyes-on checklist (ux-wow §8) once at the gate.

## 15. SEO round (T-018, T-019)
- **Approach:** keep the zero-dependency static build. Make the existing head data richer, and add one static page per project so that every project has its own indexable URL. No framework and no client-side routing.
- **Components:**
  - `src/lib/schema.mjs`: pure JSON-LD builders (`schemaIds`, `projectNode`, `homeGraph`, `projectGraph`, `jsonLdScript`).
  - `renderHead(c, { page, title, description, path, ogType, jsonLd, assets })`: one head for home, project and 404 pages.
  - `src/render/project-page.mjs`: `projectTitle`, `projectDescription`, `renderProjectPage`.
  - `projectPath(p)` in `html.mjs`.
  - `85-project.css`.
- **Data:** new `site.jobTitle`, `site.alternateName`, `contact.linkedin`, `contact.linkedinLabel` and `projectPage.*` labels, all validated. Title ≤ 65 and description ≤ 160 are enforced by validation.
- **URLs:**
  - `/` is the ProfilePage;
  - `/work/<id>/` are the project pages (canonical, `og:type` article, BreadcrumbList + CreativeWork/SoftwareSourceCode);
  - `/404.html` stays noindex.
  - The sitemap lists `/` plus every project page, with `lastmod` = build date (`build({ now })`).
- **Graph ids:** `<base>#website`, `#person`, `#org`, `#profilepage`, `#projects`, `#project-<id>`. A project node keeps the same `@id` on the home ItemList and on its own page.
- **Decisions and alternatives:**
  - Short title (60 chars) instead of the 88-char brief. Rejected because SERPs truncate it.
  - A single theme-color that follows the theme instead of a media pair. Rejected because the default is dark whatever the OS preference.
  - A 2-level JSON-LD breadcrumb. A 3-level one with `/#work` was rejected because a fragment is not a separate page.
  - No `/work/` index page. Rejected for now: the home page already lists all the work.
  - Shared OG image instead of per-project images. Per-project images were rejected: they would need a Playwright run per project.
- **Confidentiality:** case studies may link only internally. `codeRepository` is emitted only for open-source projects. Every page goes through `checkConfidential` (test + CI).
- **Risks:**
  - CSS budget: T-019 needs T-010's cap raise.
  - `sections.mjs` / `content.json` contention with T-013/T-014/T-016/T-017. Handled by sequencing (STATUS.md order).
- **Test strategy:** `seo.test.mjs` (updated pins), `seo-meta.test.mjs` (graph integrity, robots, rel=me, accessible-name audit), `project-pages.test.mjs` (every page, unique metadata, sitemap, links, confidentiality). The reviewer gate is Lighthouse mobile with SEO 100 / Perf ≥ 90 / A11y ≥ 95: local first, then SEO re-checked on the live site.

## 16. Bold round (T-022..T-026 = ux-bold B-1..B-5)
- **Spec:** `.company/ux-bold.md` (normative). Visual identity frozen; only new token `--tint-c`.
- **Approach:** keep the zero-dependency static build. Add a self-hosted motion layer: GSAP 3.15.0 + ScrollTrigger + Lenis 1.3.27, committed unmodified in `public/assets/vendor/` (copied to `dist/assets/vendor/` by the existing `public/` copy). CSP stays `script-src 'self' <theme hash>; style-src 'self'`. No npm dependency, no bundler.
- **Vendor files (as committed, names differ from ux-bold §3.1):** `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js`, `lenis.min.js`, `LICENSE-gsap.txt`, `LICENSE-lenis.txt`, `SHA256SUMS` (sha256sum format). No version in the file names and no `VERSIONS.json`; versions live in `head.mjs` `VENDOR` and in the licence text; integrity is `SHA256SUMS`, verified by `test/vendor.test.mjs`. Files are never edited, so `lenis.min.js` keeps its trailing `//# sourceMappingURL=lenis.min.js.map` line (the `.map` is not shipped; only DevTools asks for it). Cache busting: the script tags carry `?v=<VENDOR version>`.
- **Components:** `80-bold.js` core (`window.TPCT_BOLD`: shared `gsap.matchMedia`, ready queue, Lenis lifecycle, anchors, pause, print), `81-kinetic.js` (hero letters + S-mark depth scrub), `82-story.js` (pillar fan, process pin, Work rail), `83-atmos.js` (colour morphs, split-line h2). CSS partials `44-intro`, `45-bold`, `46-lenis`, `47-story`, `48-atmos`, `51-about`.
- **Load order:** `site.js` (defer) → `gsap.min.js` (defer) → `ScrollTrigger.min.js` (defer), home page only. All bold modules start on `DOMContentLoaded`: deferred scripts run while `readyState === 'interactive'` and before DCL, so "run at once if not loading" would run before the vendor code. Rule: `readyState === 'complete' ? run() : addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run, { once: true })`.
- **CSP finding (ScrollTrigger):** `ScrollTrigger.min.js` auto-registers when it executes (`window.gsap` exists) and its `enable()` does `body.style.borderTopStyle='solid'` … then, only if `<body>` had no `style` attribute before, `body.setAttribute('style','')` + `removeAttribute('style')`. Under `style-src 'self'` that `setAttribute` is a CSP violation (console error + report), once per page load. **Mitigation (T-023):** `80-bold.js` (inside `site.js`, which executes before the vendor scripts) gives `<body>` a style attribute through CSSOM (`body.style.setProperty('--st-guard','0')`, CSP-exempt) when the ScrollTrigger tag is on the page; ScrollTrigger then skips that branch. At DCL the guard property is removed via CSSOM and the then-empty attribute with `removeAttribute('style')` (not CSP-checked). Verified by a headless-Chromium `securitypolicyviolation` check in T-023 and again at the gate. Alternatives rejected: editing the vendor file (breaks checksums / licence "unmodified"); a `style=""` attribute in markup (itself an inline style under CSP); `'unsafe-inline'` or a hash for style attributes (weakens CSP).
- **Budgets:** `site.js` ≤ 39,704 B (T-023 raises the caps in `scripts.test.mjs` and `projects.test.mjs`). CSS ≤ 94,208 raw / 21,504 gzip (T-022 raises the cap in `sections.test.mjs`; moved from B-2 to B-1 so the two can run in parallel without either failing on the other's bytes). Vendor: gsap+ScrollTrigger ≤ 120,000 raw / 49,152 gzip; Lenis ≤ 20,000 / 7,168 (fine pointer only, injected later).
- **Data:** `content.about` becomes `{ title, lead[2], intro, pillarsLabel, pillars[3..4], companiesLabel, companies[6..16] }`; `paragraphs`/`factsLabel` removed (validation error if present). New icons `layers users gauge shield-check` + `hasIcon()`.
- **Decisions and alternatives:** own text splitting instead of SplitText (budget); CSS-only intro and rotator (never block on network, work without GSAP); one pinned chapter (Process) + one rail (Work) at `(min-width:1024px) and (min-height:640/720px) and (pointer: fine)`; colour morphs via 3 fixed layers' opacity (rejected: re-tinting root tokens, restyles the whole document).
- **Risks:** Lighthouse Perf < 90 from ~47 KB gzip extra JS (fallbacks in ux-bold §10, applied in order by the lead); pin-spacer breaking section rhythm (rules in `47-story.css`, QA check); long Work rail with ~20 cards (1:1 mapping per spec; if QA finds it tiring, the lead may change `end` to `dist() * 0.6` as a fix ticket); ScrollTrigger CSP branch (mitigated above).
- **Run order (max 2 Codex runs):** R1 T-022 ∥ T-023 → R2 T-024 ∥ T-026 → R3 T-025 alone → §10 gate (lead).
- **Test strategy:** one new test file per ticket (`about`, `vendor` + `bold-core`, `bold-hero`, `bold-story`, `bold-atmos`), plus the shared `scripts.test.mjs` vm smoke test and `build.test.mjs`. Each ticket also runs a throwaway headless-Chromium check script (kept outside the repo) for console/CSP errors and its own behaviour. The lead runs `npm run check`, Lighthouse mobile+desktop and eyes-on once at the gate.
